Rooted

Version

12.40.9997
July 13, 2020
Summer Update 2020

Status

Active
Rooted is a Special Condition that causes characters to not be able to move for 2 seconds. In order to avoid consecutive triggers on the same player, characters who have been rooted have a short immunity against it.

How to get Rooted

Soul War

This condition was first introduced with the Soul War Quest, being applied by Branchy Crawlers and Rotten Golems, found in the Rotten Wasteland.

Drome

When the TibiaDrome was implemented, it also made it possible to get rooted when the modifier Bad Roots is enabled.

Tibia's 25th Anniversary

During the Tibia's 25th Anniversary, it was possible to be rooted by some of the bosses available during the event.

Gnomprona

The Summer Update 2022 introduced three creatures in the Gnomprona hunting areas that can cause the condition: Gore Horn, Undertaker and Fungosaurus.

Rotten Blood

The Summer Update 2023 introduced new bosses that curse players with Bakragore's Taints once defeated. All creatures afflict players with root once players are cursed by at least three of the standard taints in the area.

How to get rid of the Rooted Condition

There is no way to get rid of this condition but by waiting for it to wear off.
